p: Barmouth sits where the Mawddach estuary meets Cardigan Bay, with the mountains of Snowdonia at its back, and the Promenade runs along a huge stretch of golden sand. That's the setting for Las Vegas Amusements, a classic stop-off when the wind picks up or the kids need a break from digging.

Do make time for Barmouth Bridge, the long timber railway viaduct across the estuary with a footpath you can walk over for some cracking views. The Mawddach Trail runs from the far end along the old railway line towards Dolgellau, flat and easy for bikes and buggies. The Cambrian Coast train stops in town, so you can arrive without the car.
